name: firecrawl-settings
description: Read or write Firecrawl's settings (namespace firecrawl-settings).

action.description: read every row, or write one.

key.description: autosaveDatasets — Auto-save run results (switch); analyzeBudget — Analysis input budget (characters) (number); loopLimit — Default loop limit (number); defaultView — Default data view (select)

value.description: The new value when writing; matches the row's declared kind.
